name: ascdii
description: Games made with the ASCDII Engine: an Explorer view of the project's assets by kind, with the objects that use each script; Lua with the engine's API in completion and on hover, and syntax errors as you type; Play in the game's window or the ASCDII editor, Stop and Build, with script errors in Problems.

settings.label: ascdii program
settings.description: The ASCDII Engine's ascdii program, or the folder it is in, such as ~/ascii-engine/bin/linux. Empty: ascdii on the PATH. The engine is at github.com/Cn8001/ASCDII-Engine.

settings.label: Play in
settings.description: Where Play opens the game. The menu beside Play picks it too.

settings.label: Show assets in Files
settings.description: Images, models, sounds and .meta files in the Explorer's Files view too. They are always in the Game view.
